core_hypothesis: Physical sorting, naming, destination assignment, distribution and catalogue construction ran on asynchronous clocks and modified one another. Destination collections could therefore inherit distinct metadata states at the moment of distribution. Later divergence may preserve initial processing-state differences rather than solely later institutional corruption.
